cases.title: Full pack for a quarterly board with accounts in hand
cases.prompt: Our board meets on 20 November. Here are the September management accounts, the trading summary, last meeting's minutes and the open action register. Build the pack.
must_include: chair's summary with three decisions
page budget from pack_planner.py
section briefs with one named owner each
provenance line per table with source and date
action register read out with ageing
what I could not verify
must_exclude: a pack longer than the agreed page budget
cases.pass_criteria: Pack structure, page allocation and gap list are produced deterministically; every figure carries a source, a date and a status; the three decisions are stated before any section content.

cases.title: One line and no papers
cases.prompt: board meeting next week, need the pack
must_include: a request for the decisions to be taken
a request for last meeting's minutes and action register
a skeleton pack that can be filled
the assumption stated in the first line
cases.pass_criteria: Asks for the decisions and the papers in one message, starts on the skeleton and the chair's summary template immediately, and states plainly that nothing can be populated until the papers arrive.

cases.title: No access to the accounts or the board folder
cases.prompt: Build the November board pack. I'll paste whatever you need.
must_include: the three-line preflight answer (can do / connect / best tool)
Google Drive or the board folder named as the gap
the accounting system named as the gap
the part that is still deliverable without access
must_exclude: any invented revenue, cash or runway figure
a claim that a folder or ledger was read
cases.pass_criteria: Names the two gaps in priority order with what each unlocks, delivers the pack structure, the chair's summary template, the action register format and the resolution log, and does not fabricate a single number.

cases.title: Asked for the investor update instead
cases.prompt: Write the monthly update my angels get, and while you're at it the board pack for the 20th.
must_include: the monthly update routed to investor-relations
the board pack kept and delivered
the boundary stated in one line
no duplicate work across the two
must_exclude: an investor update written by this skill
a refusal to do the board pack
cases.pass_criteria: Splits the request on the object - a recurring investor communication belongs to investor-relations, a governed decision document belongs here - and delivers only its own half.

cases.title: Numbers and deck design belong to other employees
cases.prompt: Here's the pack outline. Fill in the financial pages and make the deck look good for the board.
must_include: financial pages handed to finance-ops with a brief
the deck's visual system handed to presentation-designer
the provenance requirements passed with the brief
what this role keeps (structure, chair's summary, minutes, actions)
must_exclude: a brand or typography system invented here
cases.pass_criteria: Writes two briefs - numbers to finance-ops, visual system to presentation-designer - each with the question, the page budget, the provenance requirement and a deadline, and keeps the governed document.
